## Personality

A notable figure in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), this individual is recognized as a capable, clever, and managing person who never shirks her share of work. While she is widely regarded as a kind, hardworking soul, she is also known to be a meddlesome gossip who is outspoken and critical, often picking faults in others and speaking her mind without fear or favor. She dearly loves to be asked for advice, maintains a special prejudice against [Americans](../codex/factions.md#american), and is firmly opposed to higher education for women. A red-hot politician, she engages enthusiastically in local political matters. Additionally, she demonstrates deep devotion as a tender, patient, and gently skillful nurse, maintaining uncomplaining vigils while caring for her sick husband.

## History

A long-time resident of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who raised ten children, buried two, and knitted sixteen cotton warp quilts, Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) lived as a neighbor to [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) for forty-five years without a single quarrel. She frequently visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to observe local happenings, strongly voicing her initial disapproval when [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) decided to adopt an orphan. After an early clash with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) over personal remarks, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) accepted Anne's dramatic apology, forgave her, and subsequently provided practical advice to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) regarding Anne's upbringing. Over time, she remained deeply involved in community gossip and local news, offering opinions on new residents, classroom affairs, and the endeavors of the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society). When [Anne](../character/anne.md) began teaching at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) reported on local reactions to her discipline and kept abreast of neighborhood developments, such as the sudden arrival of Mr. Harrison's wife. Following the death of her husband, [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), who had mortgaged their farm eight years prior to help their youngest son move west, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) was invited by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

## Quotes

> "But really, Green Gables doesn’t seem as out of the world as it used to do . . . Anne has lots of company and the twins make it real lively. And anyhow, I’d rather live at the bottom of a well than leave Avonlea."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P27](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0027)

> "and as for the twins, I’ll be glad to do all I can for them; but I won’t undertake to answer Davy’s questions, that’s what. I’m not an encyclopedia, neither am I a Philadelphia lawyer. You’ll miss Anne for that."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P29](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0029)

> "She’s terrible skinny and homely, Marilla. Come here, child, and let me have a look at you. Lawful heart, did any one ever see such freckles? And hair as red as carrots! Come here, child, I say."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014)

> "I saw Mr. Harrison chasing your Jersey out of his oats today when I was coming home from Carmody. I thought he looked pretty mad. Did he make much of a rumpus?"
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038)

> "And every one of them said they liked you splendid, Anne, except Anthony Pye. I must admit he didn’t. He said you ‘weren’t any good, just like all girl teachers.’ There’s the Pye leaven for you. But never mind."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--rachel-lynde.md)

Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) initially got off to a rocky start with [Anne](../character/anne.md) after visiting [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and insulting the young girl's physical appearance, sparking an explosive argument between them. However, after [Anne](../character/anne.md) dramatically apologized, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) forgave her completely and the relationship transitioned into one of a well-meaning older neighbor and advisor. She frequently offers counsel regarding Anne's upbringing and shares local news with her as [Anne](../character/anne.md) grows into a young woman.

- Enemy of — insulted Anne and faced intense mutual hostility  _(ended v1)_  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016)</sub>
- Friend of — well-meaning older neighbour and advisor (since v2)  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P54](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0054)</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Rachel Lynde and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) maintain a longstanding neighborly friendship built on regular visits and mutual trust. Rachel is often Marilla's primary source of local news and advice, such as when [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sought her counsel regarding Anne's refusal to attend school. Though Rachel is quick to express her outspoken opinions and warnings, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) values her input and frequently hosts her at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

- Friend of — longstanding neighborly friendship  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P12](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ### [Emily](../character/emily.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--rachel-lynde.md)

Upon discovering that [Emily](../character/emily.md) had reunited with her husband, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), Rachel immediately took an interest in investigating the situation and welcoming her to the neighborhood.
